I am an old man now, 81 years, and my strength is not what it used to be. This small plot of beans I keep close to the house because legumes do not need much fertilizer — they feed the soil themselves, as my father taught me. I will put some manure from the goats and chickens on it, and use seed I saved from last harvest because improved bean seed is costly and hard to find here in Mzimba. My sons and their wives will help me weed, and if the work is too much for us I will pay a young man from the village for a few days.
